scope: same observer, sequential before/after, three independent deployments per mode; small fixed fixture, not randomized or a throughput approval

decision.optimization: compare already-validated canonical nextImage bytes with operation-result bytes; remove one redundant image decode and two equality serializations per historical row

limitations: sequential before/after results are diagnostic; failure-prefix call counts are not a reduction ratio
readCommitted counts exclude history replay internal to commit/recover
wall/CPU and nested call times are not additive
sequential runs and varying host load do not establish a causal speedup
a readCommitted call remains fresh per live request; byte reads/signatures are not cached
no independent SGA or actual paged five-owner path measured
first-read success is not a stable baseline: it varied between later runs, and loadAverageBefore alone does not explain the variation

checkMutations.scope: each fail() in the shared check, plus analysis-script and callsite changes

unexplainedEarlierFailures.note: one earlier full run had 3 further failures whose names were not kept; they did not recur, so the cause is unknown

nativeRerunsNotSaved.note: summaries only; raw not committed and not part of the before/after comparison
